searchText: Could we have this PR merged? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9250 Testing call starts in ~30mins: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/86466169680?pwd=x17cbD1lDCeQEWMTTOLARQhELiJV21.1 Are all clients good for a testnet release by ACD this Thursday?
